facts.fact: The Bank of Namibia issued Determination PSD-1 under section 45 of the Payment System Management Act, 2023 (Act 14 of 2023), effective on Gazette publication on 6 January 2026 (Gazette 8822, signed 19 December 2025).
PSD-1 (2026) sets a licensing process for payment services by non-bank financial institutions (paragraph 8) and defines an electronic money issuer as a licensed payment service provider.

Government Notice 251 of 2023 brought the Payment System Management Act, 2023 (Act 14 of 2023) into operation on its Gazette publication, 8 August 2023, with fee regulations for payment service provider licence applications.

facts.fact: The Payment System Management Act 14 of 2023 was promulgated in Gazette 8156 on 28 July 2023 and commenced on 8 August 2023 under Government Notice 251; the Bank of Namibia is the responsible authority.

The Bank of Namibia issued Determination PSD-12 on operational and cybersecurity standards under section 45 of the Payment System Management Act, 2023, effective on Gazette publication on 3 July 2026, replacing the 2022 PSD-12.

facts.fact: The Bank of Namibia issued Determination PSD-10 on fees and charges under section 45 of the Payment System Management Act, 2023 (Act No. 14 of 2023), effective on gazette publication on 24 December 2025 with a six-month grace period for existing providers, and it repeals the earlier PSD-5 and PSD-10 (2020) determinations.

facts.fact: PSD-10, made under the Payment System Management Act, 2023, states that it applies to all payment service providers, defined as banking institutions and non-bank financial institutions, and it binds e-money issuers and providers of e-money wallets and instant payments; new applicants and existing providers are assessed against it.

facts.fact: Bank of Namibia Directive PSDIR-11 of 16 June 2025, under the Payment System Management Act 2023, directs all payment service providers issuing payment instruments to achieve e-money interoperability through the instant payment switch by 26 February 2026.

facts.fact: The Bank of Namibia issued Directive PSDIR-10 under section 44 of the Payment System Management Act, 2023 (Act No. 14 of 2023), effective on signature on 31 March 2025, with contravention an offence.
Directive PSDIR-10 sets the regulator's deadline of 1 April 2027 for payment service providers to execute low-value cross-border Common Monetary Area transfers through the TCIB scheme.
